CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dashboard1410_read(p_date date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT (private.is_dispatcher() OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id=auth.uid() AND active AND role='driver'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '沒有權限讀取出勤資料';END IF;
 RETURN coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'service_date',service_date,'driver_id',driver_id,
  'attendance_category',attendance_category,'attendance_slot_index',attendance_slot_index,'start_time',start_time,'end_time',end_time,'note',note,'revision',revision) ORDER BY id)
  FROM public.v055_standby_shifts WHERE service_date=p_date AND review_status<>'rejected'),'[]');
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dashboard143_check_conflict(p_date date, p_driver uuid, p_vehicle bigint, p_route bigint, p_ignore bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE r public.routes%ROWTYPE;hit bigint;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.routes WHERE id=p_route;
 SELECT q.id INTO hit FROM public.runs q JOIN public.routes qr ON qr.id=q.route_id
 WHERE q.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_ignore AND q.status::text<>'cancelled'
  AND (q.driver_id=p_driver OR q.vehicle_id=p_vehicle) AND q.service_date BETWEEN p_date-1 AND p_date+1
  AND tsrange(p_date+r.default_start_time,p_date+r.default_end_time+CASE WHEN r.default_end_time<r.default_start_time THEN interval '1 day' ELSE interval '0 day' END,'[)')
  && tsrange(q.service_date+coalesce(q.planned_start_time,qr.default_start_time),q.service_date+coalesce(q.planned_end_time,qr.default_end_time)
   +CASE WHEN coalesce(q.planned_end_time,qr.default_end_time)<coalesce(q.planned_start_time,qr.default_start_time) THEN interval '1 day' ELSE interval '0 day' END,'[)') LIMIT 1;
 IF hit IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '日期 % 的司機或車輛時段與趟次 #% 重疊（含跨日）',p_date,hit;END IF;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dashboard143_guard_run()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD;END IF;
 IF NEW.status::text<>'cancelled' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_driver_days d
  WHERE d.service_date=NEW.service_date AND d.driver_id=NEW.driver_id AND d.is_leave)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '該司機當日已標示「休」，請先取消休假再新增趟次';END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF (OLD.driver_id,OLD.service_date) IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.driver_id,NEW.service_date)
   AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.daily_run_observations WHERE run_id=OLD.id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.trip_executions WHERE run_id=OLD.id))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '已有實際出勤的預排不可移至其他司機或日期';END IF;
  IF NEW.status::text='cancelled' AND OLD.status::text<>'cancelled'
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.trip_executions WHERE run_id=OLD.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '此趟次已有實際執行紀錄，須先走既有更正流程';END IF;
  -- Pin inherited actual IDs BEFORE changing a planned assignment. Never let
  -- an observation with NULL=inherit silently switch to the newly planned route.
  IF (OLD.route_id,OLD.vehicle_id) IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.route_id,NEW.vehicle_id) THEN
   UPDATE public.daily_run_observations SET actual_route_id=coalesce(actual_route_id,OLD.route_id),
    actual_vehicle_id=coalesce(actual_vehicle_id,OLD.vehicle_id),revision=revision+1
   WHERE run_id=OLD.id AND (actual_route_id IS NULL OR actual_vehicle_id IS NULL);
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NEW.status::text<>'cancelled' AND NEW.attendance_category IS NOT NULL
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.runs r JOIN public.daily_run_observations o ON o.run_id=r.id
  WHERE r.id<>NEW.id AND r.service_date=NEW.service_date AND r.driver_id=NEW.driver_id
   AND r.attendance_category=NEW.attendance_category AND r.attendance_slot_index=NEW.attendance_slot_index)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '此欄位已有獨立保留的實際出勤，請先確認該紀錄';END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END;$function$

  if new.status='completed' and old.status is distinct from 'completed'

          and w.review_status<>'rejected')

      join public.v055_driver_work_completions c on c.work_id=w.id and c.driver_id=w.driver_id
      where w.run_id=old.id and w.kind='breakdown_replacement' and w.review_status<>'rejected') then

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dashboard_close_attendance_through(p_through_date date, p_note text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE dates date[];snap jsonb;stamp timestamptz;event_id bigint;expired integer;
BEGIN
 PERFORM private.dashboard143_lock();PERFORM private.dashboard143_require_dispatcher();
 IF p_through_date IS NULL OR length(coalesce(p_note,''))>1000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '結案日期或備註不正確';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(d ORDER BY d),'{}'::date[]) INTO dates FROM (
  SELECT p_through_date d UNION SELECT service_date FROM public.runs UNION SELECT service_date FROM public.trip_executions
  UNION SELECT service_date FROM public.daily_attendance_extra_trips UNION SELECT service_date FROM public.attendance_driver_days
  UNION SELECT service_date FROM public.daily_attendance_slot_counts UNION SELECT service_date FROM public.attendance_records
  UNION SELECT service_date FROM public.v055_run_work UNION SELECT service_date FROM public.v055_standby_shifts
  UNION SELECT service_date FROM public.attendance_duty_entries
  UNION SELECT service_date FROM public.daily_attendance_closeouts
 ) known WHERE d<=p_through_date AND NOT private.dashboard146_is_closed(d);
 -- Preserve the exact current records at closing; pending proposals are not applied.
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'runs',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id) FROM public.runs r WHERE service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'trip_executions',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id) FROM public.trip_executions r WHERE service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'observations',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) ORDER BY o.id) FROM public.daily_run_observations o JOIN public.runs r ON r.id=o.run_id WHERE r.service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'extra_trips',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id) FROM public.daily_attendance_extra_trips r WHERE service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'driver_days',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY service_date,driver_id) FROM public.attendance_driver_days r WHERE service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'slot_counts',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY service_date,category) FROM public.daily_attendance_slot_counts r WHERE service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'attendance_records',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id) FROM public.attendance_records r WHERE service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'special_work',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id) FROM public.v055_run_work r WHERE service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'duty_entries',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id) FROM public.attendance_duty_entries r WHERE service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'standby',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id) FROM public.v055_standby_shifts r WHERE service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'special_completions',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.id) FROM public.v055_driver_work_completions c JOIN public.v055_run_work w ON w.id=c.work_id WHERE w.service_date=ANY(dates)),'[]'::jsonb)
 ) INTO snap;
 stamp:=clock_timestamp();
 -- Freeze reporting metadata in the same transaction as the original closing snapshot.
 snap := snap || jsonb_build_object('monthly_report',private.dashboard147_normalize_snapshot(snap,true));
 INSERT INTO public.attendance_closeout_events(action,through_date,actor_id,happened_at,reason,affected_dates,snapshot)
 VALUES('close',p_through_date,auth.uid(),stamp,btrim(coalesce(p_note,'')),dates,snap) RETURNING id INTO event_id;
 INSERT INTO public.daily_attendance_closeouts(service_date,closed_at,closed_by,supervisor_note,reopened_at,reopen_reason)
 SELECT d,stamp,auth.uid(),btrim(coalesce(p_note,'')),NULL,NULL FROM unnest(dates) d
 ON CONFLICT(service_date) DO UPDATE SET closed_at=excluded.closed_at,closed_by=excluded.closed_by,
 supervisor_note=excluded.supervisor_note,reopened_at=NULL,reopen_reason=NULL;
 UPDATE public.attendance_change_requests SET status='stale',revision=revision+1,reviewed_by=auth.uid(),reviewed_at=stamp,
 review_reason='出勤已結案；未核准的變更未套用，重新開啟後請重新送審'
 WHERE service_date<=p_through_date AND status='pending';
 GET DIAGNOSTICS expired=ROW_COUNT;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('event_id',event_id,'through_date',p_through_date,'closed_dates',dates,'expired_requests',expired);
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.v055_my_special_assignments(p_day date)
 RETURNS TABLE(work_id bigint, run_id bigint, service_date date, kind text, support_reference text, work_note text, review_status text, follow_stage_snapshot text, replacement_payee text, route_code text, route_name text, temperature_zone text, planned_start_time time without time zone, planned_end_time time without time zone, plate_number text, vehicle_label text, parent_status text, submitted_at timestamp with time zone, submission_note text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not exists (
       select 1 from public.profiles p
       where p.id=auth.uid() and p.role='driver' and p.active
  ) then raise exception '此帳號沒有司機勤務查詢權限'; end if;
  if p_day is null then raise exception '請先選擇日期'; end if;
  return query
    select w.id,w.run_id,w.service_date,w.kind,w.support_reference,w.note,
      w.review_status,w.follow_stage_snapshot,w.replacement_payee,
      coalesce(parent.route_code_snapshot,r.route_code)::text,r.route_name::text,
      coalesce(parent.temperature_zone_snapshot,r.temperature_zone)::text,
      parent.planned_start_time,parent.planned_end_time,
      v.plate_number::text,v.label::text,parent.status::text,c.completed_at,c.completion_note::text
    from public.v055_run_work w
    join public.runs parent on parent.id=w.run_id
    join public.routes r on r.id=parent.route_id
    left join public.vehicles v on v.id=w.vehicle_id
    left join public.v055_driver_work_completions c on c.work_id=w.id
    where w.driver_id=auth.uid() and w.service_date=p_day
      and w.review_status<>'rejected'
    order by parent.planned_start_time,w.id;
end $function$
